services.name: Cruise Type
services.desc: B.O.R. is a 2005 52-foot Cruisers Yachts 500 Express boat that has been completely renovated and is perfectly set up for a day of fun on the water. Her open cockpit makes this a great boat for socializing while her large foredeck sun area makes B.O.R. a popular choice for days at the Play Pen. Sleek and set up for a party, B.O.R. is a great option for celebrations, bachelor and bachelorette parties and entertaining clients. Captain Rate: For parties of 6 passengers or less, the "Yacht Captain" Add-On must be selected. This will allow us to secure your captain for your charter. Due to USCG regulations, for parties of 7 to 13 passengers, there will be additional captain fees and arrangements

services.name: Marina City Pontoon
services.desc: DEPARTS FROM THE MARINA CITY LOCATION* If you love to feel the sun on your face, then our Pontoon Boat is the one for you! At 21 feet in length, this boat has plenty of comfortable seating, including a booth-like set up around a table at the bow. Like all of our boats, our Pontoon boats come complete with non-skid woven floors, USCG required safety equipment, plush seats with backrest cushions, a radio and auxiliary cord and 2 sturdy tables with cup holders. Our waivers are digital and therefore 100% paperless. We recommend that you fill out the waiver before your trip in order to save time during the check-in process.
